# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 22 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 22 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1** [...] the wicked [...] in their error they walked [...] and they did not heed [...]

**2** [...] they turned aside from the way of Your heart, and [...] their abominations [...]

**3** [...] in the stubbornness of their heart they wandered, and [...] they did not seek You [...]

**4** [...] and they did not choose what You desire, and they did not listen [...]

**5** [...] they conspired against Your covenant, and the people of Your counsel [...]

**6** [...] they spoke against You with an insolent tongue, and they did not [...]

**7** [...] their deceitful lips, for they are not grounded in Your truth [...]

**8** [...] and in their heart they devise the schemes of Belial, and they seek You with a divided heart [...]

**9** [...] they are not grounded in Your truth, and a poisonous root [...] lurks in their intentions,

**10** [...] and in the stubbornness of their heart they wander, and they seek You through false gods [...]

**11** [...] You opened the ear of the dust-born to Your truth and [...] You instructed [...]

**12** [...] for You know every purpose behind each action, and every response of the tongue You discern,

**13** [...] You established their heart by Your [...] and by Your insight [...]

**14** [...] so that they might be preserved from sin, and [...] that they might turn from every [...]

**15** [...] and You disciplined them through the mysteries of Your wonder, and for the sake of Your glory [...]

**16** [...] You opened their ears so they might hear [...] marvelous things [...]

**17** [...] for the sake of Your name You acted, to magnify [...] truth [...]

**18** [...] and to establish the people of Your counsel among the sons of Adam [...]

**19** [...] to recount Your wonders to all generations, and through Your mighty acts [...]

**20** [...] the tongue that You formed has not turned back from its stubbornness [...]

**21** [...] but it has spoken wickedness, and the fruit of their scheming [...] they have not [...]

**22** [...] and they hardened their heart, and they did not walk in Your ways [...]

**23** [...] their soul rejected the instruction of knowledge, and they did not hold fast to truth [...]

**24** [...] and You hid Your face from them, and Your [...] they did not [...]

**25** [...] for they despised Your statutes, and their soul took no delight [...]

**26** [...] they walked in the stubbornness of their heart and did not seek [...]

**27** [...] their guilt is exceedingly great, and [...] in the fire [...]

**28** [...] and You removed them from Your covenant, and all their works [...]

**29** [...] in Your wrath You judged them, and [...] with fury [...]

**30** [...] and You cast the wicked into the consuming fire for all eternity,

**31** [...] and all the deceitful shall be no more, and the workers of wickedness [...]

**32** [...] for Your judgment is righteous, and none can endure before Your wrath [...]

**33** [...] and Your truth endures for all generations, and all [...]

**34** [...] forever and ever [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 22 presents a sustained indictment of the wicked and their eventual fiery judgment. The repetition of "stubbornness of heart" (sherirut lev) is a signature Qumran locution (cf. 1QS I:6, II:14). "Belial" retained as the sectarian name for the chief evil figure. Formal equivalence preserves the legal-prophetic tone of the original.*
